verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure SaaS that handles customer and transaction data, so a policy or control against using that data for AI model training is a fair privacy question to ask. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use restriction or related policy. SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS compliance are adjacent security attestations and do not address AI-training use of data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
